invariants.description: P_mus equals the exact Albanese (2016, eq. 2-6) waveform evaluated at t (parabolic inspiration, exponential expiration, tau = T_E/5, period 1/(1/T_resp + flag Delta_RR))
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(P_mus - (np.where((np.mod(t/(1/(1/T_resp + flag_RR_control*Delta_RR_resp)), 1.0)*T_resp) < ((T_resp/(1 + IE_ratio))*IE_ratio), (P_plEE + np.maximum(-flag_P_mus_control*Delta_P_mus, 0)) - ((P_mus_min + flag_P_mus_control*Delta_P_mus) - (P_plEE + np.maximum(-flag_P_mus_control*Delta_P_mus, 0)))/(((T_resp/(1 + IE_ratio))*IE_ratio)*(T_resp/(1 + IE_ratio)))*(np.mod(t/(1/(1/T_resp + flag_RR_control*Delta_RR_resp)), 1.0)*T_resp)**2 + ((P_mus_min + flag_P_mus_control*Delta_P_mus) - (P_plEE + np.maximum(-flag_P_mus_control*Delta_P_mus, 0)))*T_resp/(((T_resp/(1 + IE_ratio))*IE_ratio)*(T_resp/(1 + IE_ratio)))*(np.mod(t/(1/(1/T_resp + flag_RR_control*Delta_RR_resp)), 1.0)*T_resp), (P_plEE + np.maximum(-flag_P_mus_control*Delta_P_mus, 0)) + ((P_mus_min + flag_P_mus_control*Delta_P_mus) - (P_plEE + np.maximum(-flag_P_mus_control*Delta_P_mus, 0)))/(1 - np.exp(-(T_resp/(1 + IE_ratio))/((T_resp/(1 + IE_ratio))/5)))*(np.exp(-((np.mod(t/(1/(1/T_resp + flag_RR_control*Delta_RR_resp)), 1.0)*T_resp) - ((T_resp/(1 + IE_ratio))*IE_ratio))/((T_resp/(1 + IE_ratio))/5)) - np.exp(-(T_resp/(1 + IE_ratio))/((T_resp/(1 + IE_ratio))/5))))))) <= 1e-4*abs((P_mus_min + flag_P_mus_control*Delta_P_mus) - (P_plEE + np.maximum(-flag_P_mus_control*Delta_P_mus, 0))) + 1e-6

invariants.description: airway volume balance: q_l + q_t + q_b + q_A_stressed changes by the time integral of the mouth flow v_ml (trapezoid, after the 0.5 s start-up transient)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(((q_l + q_t + q_b + q_A_stressed) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*np.diff(t)*((v_ml)[1:] + (v_ml)[:-1])))))[t >= 0.5] - ((q_l + q_t + q_b + q_A_stressed) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*np.diff(t)*((v_ml)[1:] + (v_ml)[:-1])))))[t >= 0.5][0])) <= 2e-3*np.ptp((q_l + q_t + q_b + q_A_stressed)[t >= 0.5]) + 1e-9

invariants.description: thoracic volume balance: q_pl + q_t + q_b + q_A_stressed changes only through the chest-wall flow (P_mus - P_pl)/R_plwall
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(((q_pl + q_t + q_b + q_A_stressed) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*np.diff(t)*(((P_mus - P_pl)/R_plwall)[1:] + ((P_mus - P_pl)/R_plwall)[:-1])))))[t >= 0.5] - ((q_pl + q_t + q_b + q_A_stressed) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*np.diff(t)*(((P_mus - P_pl)/R_plwall)[1:] + ((P_mus - P_pl)/R_plwall)[:-1])))))[t >= 0.5][0])) <= 2e-3*np.ptp((q_pl + q_t + q_b + q_A_stressed)[t >= 0.5]) + 1e-9

invariants.description: constitutive relations: P_A = q_A_stressed/C_A + P_pl, P_pl = q_pl/C_pl, q_A = q_A_stressed + q_A_us
dead space q_D = max(q_l + q_t + q_b + unstressed volumes, q_D_min) and alveolar volume stays positive
invariants.expr: (np.max(np.abs(q_D - np.maximum(q_l + q_t + q_b + q_l_us + q_t_us + q_b_us, q_D_min))) <= 1e-12) & np.all(q_A > 0)

bc_sweep.rationale: Breathing rate 7.5-30 /min via T_resp and via the controller input Delta_RR (-0.08..+0.3 /s around 0.2 /s), inspiratory effort 1-15 cmH2O (P_mus_min, Delta_P_mus), end-expiratory pleural pressure -9..-2 cmH2O, I:E 0.3-1, airway resistance multiplier 0.5-3 (bronchoconstriction). Compliances, resistances and unstressed volumes use the default 0.5-2x factors.

baseline.reason: candidate: normal quiet-breathing values used by Albanese to tune the model (albanese2014physiology section 2.4.3: FRC 2.4 L, tidal volume ~500 ml at 12 /min, P_pl,EE -5 cmH2O, all citing west2008respiratory). With library values the model gives end-expiratory lung volume 14.0 L and VT 0.88 L (with Albanese C_A, C_b, q_A_us: 2.48 L and 0.67 L). Set up as a baseline once the parameter fix is decided.
